info.title: Public APIs — Mobile Client API
info.description:
API reference for the Public APIs Flutter mobile app. Includes anonymous device auth, email/password account linking, profile management, bookmarks, folders, discovery, categories, search, and legacy JSON endpoints.

## Authentication

Bearer-protected endpoints require:

```
Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
```

Tokens are obtained via `POST /v1/auth/anonymous` or `POST /v1/auth/login-email`.

Public endpoints (no token required): `POST /submit`, `POST /v1/apis` (auth optional, enables submission attribution), `POST /v1/auth/anonymous`, `POST /v1/auth/refresh`, `POST /v1/auth/revoke`, `POST /v1/auth/login-email`, `GET /v1/recently-added`, `GET /v1/recommend` (auth optional, personalizes with bookmarks), `GET /v1/apis/{slug}`, `GET /v1/apis/{id}/alternatives`, `GET /v1/trust-scores/{id}`, `GET /v1/apis/compare`, `GET /v1/change-feed`, `GET /v1/use-case-collections`, categories (unversioned and `/v1` aliases), `GET /search`, `GET /metadata`, `POST /track`, and `POST /admin/v1/contact-messages`. Every other `/v1/*` operation requires a Bearer token.

## Account Types
- **Anonymous**: Device-only, no email. Data tied to device fingerprint.
- **Email-linked**: Has email + password. Can login from any device. Data merges on link.

## Token Lifecycle
- **Access token**: 15 minutes, used for API requests
- **Refresh token**: 30 days, used to rotate access tokens
- Refreshing a token invalidates the old one (single-use rotation)
- Revoking deactivates all tokens for a device

200.description: Duplicate link — already submitted and approved

post.description:
Create or resume an anonymous device session. If the device has an active refresh token, returns a new access token without creating a new session (200). Otherwise, creates a new device session with refresh + access tokens (201).

This is the entry point for the Flutter app — no account creation required.

200.description: Existing device — tokens re-issued (refreshToken is null)

201.description: New device created — full token pair issued

post.description: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token. The old refresh token is invalidated (single-use rotation).
Deactivate all tokens for a device. The device will need to re-authenticate via `/v1/auth/anonymous`.

Links the current anonymous device to an email/password account. If the email already exists on another device, bookmarks and folders are merged to that device and the current device is deactivated (user receives new tokens for the existing account). After linking, the user can login from any device via `/v1/auth/login-email`.
Authenticate with email and password. Returns access + refresh tokens. Only works for accounts that have been linked via `/v1/auth/link-email`.

get.description: Returns full user profile including name, email (if linked), auth provider, device info, and aggregated stats (bookmarks count, folders count, folder items count, days since creation, member since date).

put.description: Update the current user's profile. Currently only supports updating the name field.

delete.description: Permanently delete the current user's account and all associated data including bookmarks, folders, FCM tokens, and reports. This action is irreversible.

get.description: Returns the latest published APIs in the legacy flat item format. Ordered by creation date descending.

Returns API recommendations. If a valid Bearer token is provided and the user has bookmarks, returns personalized results scored by shared category, auth type, API type, pricing type, and description keywords with the user's bookmarked APIs. If no bookmarks or no token, returns random APIs.

Results are in the legacy recommendation format.
